sample.task:
[there would be dialogue in this story, which would start from the very moment Nitazar was starting to be born:]

(While the Dragon Isles were home to the dracthyrs, one particular dracthyr stands out from the rest - Nitazar. He's known as the "Black Dracthyr of the horde" - and for good reason. He was born to Razk - a dracthyr that was a member of the Dark Talons - during Shara Ishvalda's invasion from another world, but the other dracthyrs were shocked as to how Nitazar's scales were black - while his mother's scales were dark blue. Without another word, the dracthyrs abandoned the newborn Nitazar in a remote part of the Dragon Isles. Distraught at losing her only child, Razk left the Dark Talons - and was never seen again. However, Nitazar was taken after by Emberthal - the lead Scalecommander. However, when Nitazar was 17, terrible news had spread throughout the Dragon Isles - Cindrethresh, the Scalecommander of the Dark Talons, had tragically died; and no successors have taken on role of the Horde Scalecommander. Without as so much of a word, Nitazar took his spot as the new Scalecommander of the Dark Talons - and spread his influence far beyond the Dragon Isles - in fact, it even reached the home place of other Horde races; like the blood elves, undead, orcs, and tauren. Nitazar's glaring red eyes brought fear to all who opposed him - and nobody has tried taking the role of Scalecommander of the Dark Talons since then.)
sample.chosen:
The air crackled with primal energy as Razk, scales shimmering a deep, sapphire blue, strained against the throes of labor. Around her, the other dracthyr of the Dark Talons watched with a mixture of anticipation and apprehension. This was a momentous occasion, the birth of a new generation.

A piercing cry tore through the cavern, followed by a gasp of shock from the assembled dracthyr. Emerging from the birthing pool, swaddled in Razk's protective wings, was a hatchling unlike any they had ever seen. His scales, instead of the expected deep blues and purples, were a stark, obsidian black.

"By the Aspects..." a dracthyr murmured, his voice laced with disbelief.

Whispers rippled through the crowd. "A black dracthyr? Never before..."

Razk, exhausted but filled with maternal love, nuzzled her newborn son. "Nitazar," she whispered, her voice thick with emotion. "My little shadow."

But the awe quickly turned to fear. Superstition ran deep among the dracthyr, and a black hatchling was seen as an ill omen.

"He is tainted," hissed a dracthyr elder, his eyes narrowed with suspicion. "A harbinger of darkness."

The whispers grew louder, fueled by fear and prejudice. Razk, her heart breaking, felt the gazes of her brethren turn cold and accusatory.

"He is my son," she roared, her voice echoing through the cavern. "He is innocent!"

But her pleas fell on deaf ears. The other dracthyr, consumed by their fear, backed away, their eyes filled with disgust.

"Leave him," one hissed. "He is not one of us."

Tears streamed down Razk's face as she realized the truth. Her son, her precious Nitazar, was being cast out.

With a final, heart-wrenching glance at her son, Razk scooped him up and fled the cavern, leaving behind the whispers and the judgment. She vowed to protect Nitazar, no matter the cost.

But fate had other plans.

Days later, a lone figure stumbled upon a whimpering hatchling, abandoned and alone. It was Emberthal, the lead Scalecommander, a dracthyr known for his wisdom and compassion.

He knelt beside the black hatchling, his eyes filled with pity. "Little one," he murmured, gently stroking Nitazar's scales. "You are safe now."

Emberthal took Nitazar under his wing, raising him as his own. He taught him the ways of the dracthyr, instilling in him a sense of justice and honor.

Years passed, and Nitazar grew into a powerful and formidable dracthyr. His black scales, once a symbol of fear, became a badge of courage and resilience.

Then, tragedy struck. News spread like wildfire through the Dragon Isles: Cindrethresh, the Scalecommander of the Dark Talons, had perished. The Horde was leaderless, vulnerable.

Nitazar, now a young adult, felt a surge of responsibility. He knew what he had to do.

Without a word, he strode into the heart of the Dark Talons' stronghold. His red eyes, burning with determination, met the gazes of the assembled dracthyr.

"I am Nitazar," he declared, his voice resonating with power. "Son of Razk, and heir to the legacy of the Dark Talons. I will lead you."

A hush fell over the crowd. Some looked at him with suspicion, remembering the whispers of his birth. But others saw in him the strength and leadership they desperately needed.

One by one, the dracthyr bowed their heads in submission. Nitazar, the Black Dracthyr of the Horde, had risen. His influence spread far beyond the Dragon Isles, reaching the hearts of the Horde races.

Fear and respect followed him wherever he went. For Nitazar, the outcast, had become a legend.

**Dialogue begins as Nitazar is born:**

**Midwife Dracthyr:** (gasps) "By the dragons, Razk, your hatchling... his scales... they're black!"

**Razk:** (weakly) "Black? But... that's not possible. Our line has always been dark blue."

**Another Dracthyr:** "This is unnatural, Razk. He does not belong here."

**Razk:** "What do you mean? He's my son!"

**Elder Dracthyr:** "He is an abomination. He must be taken away, for the good of our kind."

**Razk:** (cries out) "No! Please, don't take him from me!"

**Elder Dracthyr:** "It is for the best, Razk. We will leave him in a remote part of the isles. Perhaps the dragons will show him mercy."

**Razk:** (sobs) "Nitazar... my poor Nitazar..."

---

**Years later, Emberthal finds Nitazar:**

**Emberthal:** "Well, well, what do we have here? A little black dracthyr, all alone?"

**Young Nitazar:** (hisses weakly) "Leave me alone."

**Emberthal:** (laughs) "Feisty one, aren't you? I like that. You're coming with me, little one. The Horde could use someone like you."

---

**Years pass, and Nitazar learns of Cindrethresh's death:**

**Messenger Dracthyr:** "Nitazar, I bring grave news. Cindrethresh, our Scalecommander, has fallen."

**Nitazar:** (red eyes gleaming) "Who will take his place?"

**Messenger Dracthyr:** "No one has stepped forward. The Dark Talons are in disarray."

**Nitazar:** "Then I shall take his place. I will lead the Dark Talons, and the Horde will know fear."

---

**Nitazar addresses the Horde races:**

**Nitazar:** "Hear me, races of the Horde! I am Nitazar, the Black Dracthyr, your new Scalecommander! You will follow me, or you will fall. There is no other way."

**Blood Elf:** (whispers) "His eyes... they're like embers of hatred."

**Orc:** (grunts) "We follow strength. He has it."

**Undead:** (rasps) "The Horde will rise again, under the black wings of Nitazar."

**Tauren:** (nods) "The spirits guide him. We will follow."

---

**And so, Nitazar's reign as Scalecommander begins, his glaring red eyes striking fear into all who dare oppose him.**
